info.title: Mobile Systems API
info.description: JSON API for accounts, users, the daily internship report and application drafts. Log in with `POST /api/auth/login`, then send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

token.description: The new bearer token. Every previous token is revoked.

field.description: The record field the claim states, e.g. `compensation`.

verdict.description: The verifier's verdict, checked by code; `unverified` when it was not checked (the verifier failed or was not configured).

evidence.description: On `supported` claims: an excerpt of at most 300 characters from the page.

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description:
One checked fact about a top-K offer. Text and evidence came from the web: show them
as text, never as HTML.

mine.description: False for a draft shared with you by its owner.

coverLetter.description: Whether a cover letter was asked for.

error.description: Why the draft is partial or failed.

profileOutdated.description: Made with an older profile than the owner's.

Draft.title: Draft
Draft.description: A tailored CV (and cover letter) for one offer, by its owner.

DraftCheck.title: DraftCheck
DraftCheck.description: Something code changed or rejected in the model's plan. Show as text.

drafts.description: Yours and those shared with you, newest first.

section.description: `new` since the last run, still in the `top_k`, `dropped` from the last run's top K or closed this run, or also `open`.

previousRank.description: The rank in the last run, if it had one.

dropReason.description: Why a `dropped` offer left the report's top K. Null in other sections.

deadlinePassed.description: The deadline is a date before today (UTC).

workAuthorizationQuote.description: The posting's own words, quoted. Never a judgment.

fitScore.description: Fit with the candidate's profile, 0 to 3. Null if not rated.

fitReason.description: One sentence on the fit. Null if not rated.

claims.description: Top-K offers only: each checked claim.

InternshipOffer.title: InternshipOffer
InternshipOffer.description:
One opportunity as the run reported it. Fields the posting doesn't state are
`unknown` (or null for pay, deadline and the work-authorization quote).

run.description: Null until the first run is published.

files.description: Empty until a profile is uploaded.

canDraft.description: Whether this account may upload a profile and draft.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: The caller's own applicant profile: file names, sizes and hashes, never contents.

username.description: 3-30 letters, digits, `_` or `.`. Case-insensitive; stored lowercased.

title.description: Empty when the document was not fetched.

status.description: `skipped`: already seen. `rejected`: refused by a fetch guardrail.

reason.description: Why it was rejected or failed.

TrackerArticle.title: TrackerArticle
TrackerArticle.description:
One document a run tried to read. Title and URL came from the web: show them as
text, and link the URL only when it is http(s).

failedServices.description: Worker services that failed in the run, e.g. `verifier`. Empty if none.
Worker services that failed in the run, e.g. `verifier`. Empty if none.

sections.description: How many offers the run reported in each section, e.g. `new`.

articles.description: How many documents the run tried to read, by status, e.g. `fetched`.

TrackerRunSummary.title: TrackerRunSummary
TrackerRunSummary.description: One published run and what changed in it, for the run history.
